_meta.purpose: Mock dataset for BIS AI Assistant prototype (SIH Problem Statement 26107)
_meta.note: Compiled from PUBLICLY available BIS scheme pages and certification-consultant sites. Full IS standard text is NOT free/public and must be purchased from BIS or accessed via an official BIS data-sharing agreement in production. This mock data covers product name, applicable IS number, scheme type, and basic scope only — sufficient for a hackathon demo of the matching/RAG logic.

schemes.ISI: Scheme I - Mandatory factory inspection + license. Used for items like cement, steel, pressure cookers, LPG stoves.
schemes.CRS: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme. Self-declaration + testing, no factory inspection. Used for electronics/IT and solar goods.
schemes.Hallmarking: Purity certification scheme for gold and silver jewellery.
schemes.FMCS: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme - for overseas manufacturers selling regulated products in India.
schemes.Voluntary: No mandatory QCO; manufacturer may opt in for ISI mark voluntarily.

ISI: Apply online via BIS Manak Online portal
Submit product test report from BIS-recognized lab
Grant of license and ISI mark usage rights
CRS: Identify applicable IS/IEC standard for the product
Get product tested at a BIS-recognized/NABL-accredited lab (report valid 90 days)
Submit self-declaration + test report via CRS portal (crsbis.in)
Affix BIS Standard Mark with R-number on product
Hallmarking: Register as a jeweller with BIS
Get jewellery tested and hallmarked at a BIS-recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre
Hallmark stamped includes BIS mark, purity grade, AHC mark, and unique HUID number
